The '''Trans-Jardeen sector''' lay in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and contained the [[Jardeen system/Legends|Jardeen system]] and the [[Pioku system/Legends|Pioku system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The Jardeen [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jardeen IV]], the site of the [[Imperial Army training center]]<ref name="WbC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref> that was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for teaching the tactics of utilizing [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] in combat.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|140|Jardeen IV}}</ref> The Pioku system shared its name with the conflict known as the [[Pioku Border Wars]].<ref name="Death Star Coup">{{InsiderCite|Special Edition 2014|A Certain Point of View|A Certain Point of View: The Death Star Coup}}</ref>

By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Trans-Jardeen [[Sector/Legends|sector]] bordered the [[Great Agash sector/Legends|Great Agash sector]] northward and the [[Extorin sector/Legends|Extorin sector]] and the [[Cantons of Lahag/Legends|Cantons of Lahag]] westward. It also formed a four-way border with the [[Arc d'Stot sector/Legends|Arc d'Stot]], [[Chitarghar sector/Legends|Chitarghar]], and [[Vatha sector/Legends|Vatha sectors]] eastward, as well as another four-way border with the [[Har Worlds]], the [[Piryn Shar sector/Legends|Piryn Shar sector]], and the Vatha sector southward.<ref name="Expansion" /> Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="WbC" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arndall Lott]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Iolan Gendarr]] of the Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Reliance (Star Destroyer)|''Reliance'']], both stationed on Jardeen IV, fled the planet before the arrival of [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic forces]].<ref name="WbC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Trans-Jardeen sector was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[2012]], the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://web.archive.org/web/20170806141020/https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," which placed it in grid squares J-15, K-15, and K-16.<ref name="Expansion" />
